A human hand enters the frame from the left to pet the cat's belly and head. The cat stands up and walks toward the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic synth-pop BGM. A male narrator speaks in a fast, energetic tone using a mix of Mandarin and Hokkien. The background room tone is clean. (2) A sharp, loud cat meow (Animal Sound) interrupts the speech. The meow has a high pitch and moderate duration. The BGM continues steadily in the background. (3) Another distinct meow, slightly lower in pitch than the previous one, occurs as a response. The narrator continues his commentary between meows. (4) A rapid sequence of meows from two different acoustic signatures (one sharper, one raspier) occurs. These meows represent the 'argument' between the cats. A subtle digital whoosh SFX marks a transition. (5) A final cat vocalization occurs that sounds remarkably like a high-pitched human saying 'Hello'. The narrator reacts with a light, warm chuckle and a final friendly comment.
